Body.Content:
Organizations can now control how work order services contribute to project financials when using Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations together. A new administrator-level setting lets organizations choose whether work order services flow as time or material transactions based on how they manage field execution and technician labor.

GA date: November CY2026
